summary: Iteration 8 — End-to-end tracking flow validated. Created /app/backend/tests/test_tracking_flow_e2e.py (17 tests, 100% pass) covering the full lifecycle: POST /api/delivery-requests → GET /api/track/{tn} → PATCH /admin/delivery-requests/{id}/assign → PATCH /admin/delivery-requests/{id}/status. All French status_label mappings verified (En attente de prise en charge, Assigné à un livreur, En cours de livraison, Livré). Email graceful-failure path verified via backend logs: Resend returned 'You can only send testing emails to your own email address' on every send attempt (create, assign, en_cours, livre) yet every endpoint returned 200 — confirming send_notification_email catches the exception and returns False without propagating. In-app notification code path is exercised (rider notification on assign + status_changed) via delivery lifecycle. Public tracking response correctly excludes financial fields (commission_plateforme, paiement_livreur, prix_total). Unknown tracking numbers return 404.
critical_code_review_comments: send_notification_email (server.py L343-370) wraps resend.Emails.send in try/except and returns False on any Exception — verified in production logs: 4xx errors from Resend never bubble up to the caller. This is the correct pattern.

GET /api/track/{tracking_number} (L649-680) correctly whitelists returned fields (no financial data leak) and maps status → French label via a dict lookup. All 4 primary statuses (nouveau/assigne/en_cours/livre) return the exact strings expected by the frontend.

PATCH /admin/delivery-requests/{id}/status (L1545-1671) triggers email + in-app notifications for both en_cours and livre transitions. Emails fire asynchronously via asyncio.to_thread — no blocking of the HTTP response.

Rider counter maintenance in status update (L1558-1597) is correct: increments livraisons_en_cours on assign, transfers to total_livraisons on livre, handles reversals (livre→other, annule↔active, →nouveau reset). One subtle case handled: →nouveau resets livreur_id + assigned_at + completed_at when transitioning from assigne/en_cours.
Public delivery creation (POST /api/delivery-requests) strips commission_plateforme and paiement_livreur before returning to the anonymous caller — good separation of internal vs public data.

Minor observation (not a bug): backend logs are spammed with Resend ERROR lines during any delivery mutation because sandbox mode blocks all recipients ≠ badiroumounif@gmail.com. In production with a verified domain this will disappear. If desired, main agent can downgrade the log level to WARNING for the specific 'You can only send testing emails' Resend error string, but this is purely cosmetic.
